one_liner.zh: 本周加密走出相对独立节奏：BTC 窗口 +3.4%、高位震荡里夹杂上涨段清算挤压，实现波动仍高而 IV 与 RV 大致匹配，现货 ETF 维持温和流入。
one_liner.en: Crypto moved with relative independence this week: BTC +3.4% in high-level chop with upside liquidation-squeeze traces, realized vol still elevated while IV roughly matched RV, and spot ETFs kept a mild inflow.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 +9.87 亿美金

risk.zh: 高实现波动叠加 09-03「清算∥OI 同日尖峰」后 09-04 回吐：若高位震荡再切单边，类似双高日后的退烧仍可能放大日内振幅（side 未定，只谈结构）。
risk.en: High RV plus the 09-03 liq∥OI same-day spike and 09-04 giveback: if high chop breaks one-sided, a similar post-dual-high cool-down can still amplify intraday swings (side unset; structure only).

watch.zh: 盯：是否再现 09-03 类「清算峰值与 OI 日高同日」结构；OI 与 funding 是否在无新双高事件下重新堆积；温和 ETF 流入是否延续（通道与杠杆分开看）。
watch.en: Watch: whether another 09-03-like same-day liq peak ∥ OI daily high reappears; whether OI and funding rebuild without a new dual-high event; whether mild ETF inflow persists (channel vs leverage tracked apart).

leverage.zh: 清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）

vol_premium.zh: IV 与 RV 大致匹配

compare.zh: BTC +3.4%、ETH +4.0%，明显强于同期美股括号内近乎走平的 ES（0%）与仅微升的 NQ（+0.25%）；VIX 小幅抬升、美元与黄金偏弱，传统风险资产并未给出同向主线，标签落在「加密偏独立」。
compare.en: BTC +3.4% and ETH +4.0% outpaced the tradfi bracket’s flat ES (0%) and barely higher NQ (+0.25%); VIX edged up while DXY and gold softened, so traditional risk did not supply a shared tape—label reads crypto-idiosyncratic.

path.zh: 路径不是顺畅单边趋势，而是高位震荡：价格重心上移的同时反复消化杠杆。节奏锚点升为价+清算+OI——9 月 3 日清算与 OI 同日周高、价格约 +5.1%，9 月 4 日退烧（价约 −2%、OI/费率回吐），上涨段带有事件型挤压痕迹而非干净突破。
path.en: Path is high chop, not a clean one-way trend: price center drifts up while leverage is digested. Rhythm anchor = price + liq + OI — Sep 3 same-day liq and OI week highs with ~+5.1% price, Sep 4 cool-down (~−2%, OI/funding giveback); up-leg shows event-squeeze traces, not a clean breakout.

leverage.zh:
标签：清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +7.97%/yr → 期末约 +3.16%/yr，租金全周降温；OI 周变约 −0.73%（106341 → 105565），全周库存仅略降——更像事件周，而非匀速去杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主戏在 09-03——清算笔数与 qty 峰值同日，且与 OI 日高同日（约 112737，周内最高）；峰值约 3.4× 周内中位清算量，价格同日约 +5.1%。当日 OI↑ 且清算↑，读作改仓/挤压日，而非慢速拆仓。次日 09-04：OI 自周高回落、funding 年化骤降至约 +1.1%/yr、价格约 −2.0%——一日高潮、次日退烧。side 语义未核验，此处只并陈结构，不判多空谁爆。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 762.88 亿美金，WoW 约 −14.7%，活跃度中性；量偏淡，说明主戏是事件尖峰而非全周热换手。
收句：拥挤线降温 + 出清线「09-03 双高 → 09-04 退烧」共同支撑「清算驱动/上涨段挤压迹象」标签；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: liquidation-driven (upside squeeze traces).
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+7.97%/yr → ~+3.16%/yr — rent cooled; OI week change ~−0.73% (106341 → 105565), inventory only slightly lower — an event week, not steady deleveraging.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): main act 2026-09-03 — liq count and qty peaks same day and same day as OI daily high (~112737, week max); peak ~3.4× median liq qty; price ~+5.1% that day. OI↑ with liq↑ reads as reposition/squeeze day, not slow unwind. Next day 09-04: OI off the week high, funding ann. crashed to ~+1.1%/yr, price ~−2.0% — one-day climax, next-day cool-down. Side semantics unverified; structure only, no long/short call.
③ Volume side-check (perp turnover = activity): ~76.29B USD, WoW ~−14.7%, activity normal — soft tape, event spike not week-long heat.
Close: cooling crowding + flush line “09-03 dual-high → 09-04 fade” support the squeeze label; do not treat liq/OI/funding as the cause of the move.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 +9.87 亿美金（温和流入；4 入 1 出，单日最大净流入落在 9 月 3 日），ETH ETF 约 +2.18 亿美金；并陈看，Binance 等口径现货成交额周合计约 78.60 亿美金、环比 -18.16%，现货通道有净流入但交易所现货热闹度同步降温，不把净流与涨跌焊成因果。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs saw ~+986.85M net (mild inflow; 4 in / 1 out, largest daily net on Sep 3); ETH ETFs ~+218.41M. Alongside, spot exchange turnover summed ~7.86B (−18.16% WoW): spot channel took net creations while exchange spot activity cooled—flow and price path are juxtaposed, not causally welded.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 78.60 亿美金，相对上完整周 -18.2%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 96.05 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-09-03（15.80 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 762.88 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 7.86B, vs prior full week -18.2% (activity “normal”; prior ~9.61B). Peak day 2026-09-03 (1.58B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (76.29B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV 描述的是已经走完的路径起伏；IV 是期权市场对往后波动的定价。两者大致匹配时，说明期权并未明显贵买或贱卖「下一阶段的波动」，更多是在兑现本周已经发生的振幅。
vol_teach.en: High RV describes path roughness already realized; IV is the options market’s price of future vol. When they roughly match, options are neither clearly rich nor cheap versus the next leg—they are largely reflecting the amplitude already delivered.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 43.4%，仍处高实现波动带；期末 Deribit IV 约 39.3%，IV−RV 点差约 -4.0 个百分点，标签为 IV 与 RV 大致匹配。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~43.4% ann. kept the high-RV band; end Deribit IV ~39.3%, IV−RV spread ~−4.0 pct pts, labeled IV roughly matched to RV.

vol_combo.zh: 高实现波动 + IV 公允，叠加清算驱动的短节奏，意味着波动来自真实成交与被迫调仓，而非单纯的期权溢价扩张；ETH 端 IV/RV（约 53%/47%）同样偏高位、结构相近。
vol_combo.en: High RV with fair IV plus liquidation-driven short rhythm points to vol from real flow and forced de-risking rather than pure options-premium expansion; ETH’s IV/RV (~53%/47%) sits similarly elevated with a comparable structure.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周线上涨约 3.4% 的同时 IV 并未脱离 RV 向上失控，说明上涨更多消耗在震荡与挤压里，而不是「越涨越贵的波动保险」。
vol_price_iv.en: Price rose ~3.4% on the week while IV did not runaway above RV, so the advance was spent more in chop and squeezes than in ever-dearer vol insurance.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 括号内约 +0.7%，传统恐慌仅轻微抬头；加密侧 RV 更高、且走独立标签，两边波动温度计本周并未锁死同步。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~+0.7% in its bracket—only a mild tradfi unease tick—while crypto RV ran higher under an idiosyncratic link, so the two vol thermometers were not locked in sync.

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元略弱可作弱背景，不是主引擎。
vs_crypto.en: Mild USD softness is backdrop, not the main engine.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与币关系需看结构，不宜硬套。
vs_crypto.en: Link to crypto is structural—not mechanical.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号（口述仍称本报告周）ES 走平、NQ 微涨，十年期美债收益率 +6.4 bp，DXY -0.54%，黄金 -1.08%；传统资产呈利率略抬、美元与金偏弱的混合盘，对加密既未明显抽风险也未提供强顺风。
tradfi_summary.en: In the US session bracket (spoken as this report week) ES was flat, NQ slightly up, US10Y +6.4 bp, DXY −0.54%, gold −1.08%: a mixed tape of firmer yields and softer dollar/gold that neither clearly drained risk from crypto nor supplied a strong tailwind.

three_conclusions.zh: 价格与传统资产脱钩上涨；主叙事是加密内部高位震荡，以及 09-03 清算∥OI 同日尖峰后的事件型挤压（非宽基风险齐步）。
three_conclusions.en: Crypto rose decoupled from TradFi; the core read is internal high chop plus an event squeeze after the 09-03 same-day liq∥OI spike (not a broad risk-on march).

three_conclusions.zh: 波动上 RV 仍高、IV 大致跟上，期权层没有额外「恐慌溢价」扩张，振幅更多来自现货—杠杆交易本身。
three_conclusions.en: Vol-wise RV stayed high and IV roughly kept pace—no extra panic premium balloon in options; amplitude came more from spot–leverage trading itself.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货 ETF 温和净流入与交易所现货/永续成交额环比下滑并陈，通道有钱进、场内热闹度却在降，值得分开跟踪。
three_conclusions.en: Mild ETF net inflow sat beside cooler spot/perp turnover WoW: money entered the channel while venue activity cooled—track the two separately.

text.zh: 下一周 BTC 现货 ETF 合计净流是否仍维持「温和流入」或转为流出（对照本周 +9.87 亿美金与 4 入 1 出）。
text.en: Whether next week’s combined BTC spot ETF net stays mild inflow or flips to outflow (vs this week’s +986.85M and 4 in / 1 out).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周通道标签温和且与价格上涨并陈但未焊死因果，净流能否延续是下期最直接的外部核对哨。

text.zh: 高实现波动（本周 RV ~43%）是否回落至更中性带，同时 IV−RV 是否仍大致匹配、不出现大幅转正或转负。
text.en: Whether high realized vol (RV ~43% this week) cools toward a neutral band while IV−RV stays roughly matched without a large rich/cheap swing.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周矛盾在「振幅已高但期权并不明显贵」，若 RV 不降而 IV 突然脱节，叙事会从公允切到溢价/折价。

text.zh: 清算驱动挤压是否消退：是否再现「清算高峰与 OI 日高/大涨日对齐」的 09-03 类双高结构，或仅有清算峰而无 OI 同日顶；OI 与 funding 在无新双高时是否重新抬升。
text.en: Whether squeeze traces fade: another 09-03-like dual-high (liq peak aligned with OI daily high / big up day), or liq peak without same-day OI top; whether OI and funding lift again without a new dual-high.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 杠杆标签是本周路径关键注解；「类似 9/3」应核对是否双高对齐，而非只数清算笔数。

matched.zh: 高位震荡 + 清算挤压反复出现，价格路径更像区间内的来回兑现而非单边延伸，与均值回归类逻辑的「偏离后回拉、事件后归一」观察面相合（仅解释标签匹配，非推荐）。
matched.en: High chop with repeated liquidation squeezes made the path look like two-way digestion inside a range rather than one-way extension, aligning with mean-reversion’s observational face of pullbacks after stretches and normalization after events (label match only, not a recommendation).

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随更依赖可持续的方向与回撤可控的延伸；本周标签为高位震荡且杠杆以清算驱动为主，方向信号易被日内挤压打断，故与趋势跟随观察面错位。
mismatched.en: Trend-following leans on durable direction and controlled extension; this week’s high-chop label and liquidation-driven leverage meant directional signals were easily interrupted by intraday squeezes, mismatching that lens.
